canonical_project: Galaxy Backbone National Shared Services Centre (NSSC) Abuja
notes: Official Galaxy Backbone FAQ confirms an Uptime Institute Tier III data centre in Abuja (Tier IV in Kano, outside this batch). Guardian (2026) reports the only Uptime Tier III public-sector DC at ~38% utilisation of ~2.5 MW capacity; Nairametrics (2024) cites ~128 rack spaces scalable to 512 (2019 build). Capacity_mw 2.5 is a press-reported figure (B-grade estimate); facility existence is A-grade via operator official page and Uptime. Hosts federal shared services; do not duplicate GBB hosted-state partnerships as new facilities elsewhere.
